description: This file contains functions to map internal data models (User and PainEvent) into FHIR-compliant JSON resources, including Patient, Observation, and a Bundle that encapsulates these resources for external interoperability.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] map_user_to_patient(user: User)
methods.description: Converts a User instance into a FHIR Patient resource dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] map_pain_event_to_observation(pain_event: PainEvent)
methods.description: Converts a PainEvent instance into a FHIR Observation resource dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_fhir_bundle(user: User, pain_events: List[PainEvent])
methods.description: Creates a FHIR Bundle containing Patient and Observation resources for the given user and list of pain events.

ctags.name: create_fhir_bundle
ctags.pattern: /^def create_fhir_bundle(user: User, pain_events: List[PainEvent]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
